final_cooling_increment_note: Use initialInc=0.01 and maxInc=60.0 for step_final_cooling where supported. Do not interpret max increment size as maxNumInc=60.
scan_order_mapping_rule: At sequence index seq, activate heat set set_body_heat_{track:02d}, where track = scan_order[seq].
load_lifecycle_rule: Each scan step creates one BodyHeatFlux load on the target track set; the load is deactivated in the following cooling step and remains inactive through final cooling.
pilot_validation_basis: N12_A01_raster_left_to_right previously passed pilot INP text check; regeneration changes only final cooling increment controls.
